function.name: SET_POINT
function.param: Number of graph inside of library
Number of point of control (0 to 999)
New value for horizontal coordinate of the point
New value for vertical coordinate of the point
function.abstract: It allows to change a point of control of a graph

description.p: A graph can contain up to 999 points of control of which the point of control 0 represents the center of the graph, and the rest is available for the user. By this function a point of control of any graph can be assigned: if the graph did not contain points of control, or did not contain enough points of control, then the necessary points of control will be added. For example, if a graph has not points of control and by this function the point of control 20 is added, the points of control 0 to 19 will be filled up with the indefined value (-1, -1).
